identity.description: This scenario simulates a ransomware precursor that deletes volume shadow copies and disables system recovery mechanisms before encryption. Cortex should detect the execution of vssadmin, wbadmin, and bcdedit commands with specific parameters.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

payload.code:
vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet
bcdedit.exe /set recoveryenabled no
wbadmin.exe delete catalog -quiet

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of vssadmin.exe with delete shadows parameters
Execution of bcdedit.exe with recoveryenabled no
Execution of wbadmin.exe with catalog delete parameters

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
biocs.description: Detection of vssadmin.exe deleting shadow copies
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe' and action_command_line contains 'delete shadows'
| filter action_command_line contains '/all /quiet'
